title: anim.flight/1
description: data/anim/flight.json: the flight lead (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, _lead_layer; docs/animation/pose-pipeline.md section 9.23, GB-006): a launched body that has stopped tumbling flies head first along its velocity, a fighter carried fast with his head against the way he goes is stood up to a tilt cap. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

speed.description: units/s over which the lead comes in (from, to)

spin.description: |spin| in rad/s under which the lead comes in (from, to)

steep.description: a fall steeper than this (down over across, from, to) is not chased

rate.description: 1/s: how fast the turn chases its aim or lets go

skid_rate.description: 1/s: the same, landing into a skid

tilt.description: degrees: the most a fighter carried fast against his head's way is left tilted

tilt_rate.description: 1/s: the same for the knockback tilt

lay.description: sine of the spine's tilt over which a pose that lays the body out is flown head first in a skid (from, to)

pivot_y.description: the body's middle in model space (the view's PIVOT_Y)
